name: Highschool Possession
source: Hikaru was just a normal young man with a crush on two girls at school, that is until his whole world changed as he literally had to walk in the shoes of his dream girls... Only to find his school idols were not so perfect after all.
translation: Hikaru只是一个普通的年轻人，在学校迷恋着两个女孩，直到他的整个世界发生了变化，因为他不得不站在他梦中女孩的立场上行走……却发现他的学校偶像毕竟不是那么完美。
